In my classroom we will have flexible lessons depending on what you’re interested in learning! I want to emphasize conversational English and getting used to speaking and explaining your own ideas.  

I believe the best way to learn grammar and vocabulary is by doing and repetition, so I will encourage you to speak, finish sentences, and make your own sentences! 

I understand how difficult it can be to learn a new language, but we can work hard together!

pro_course_detail.title: English For Adults
pro_course_detail.description: In this class we can practice conversational English!  If you have a topic that you are interested we can talk about that and other related vocabulary.  I can correct any mistakes and also answer any of your questions! If you are interested in a particular subject, or learning grammar , or practicing vocabulary related to your field we can focus on that as well!

pro_course_detail.title: English for Kids
pro_course_detail.description:
In these lessons I plan to do more structured lessons based around a reading that I provide or something that the student needs particular help with that they can send ahead of class time or bring to the lesson. 
I have experience teaching english to kindergarten and elementary grades 1, 3, and 5. We can read short stories or non fiction then discuss with comprehension questions. 
If this is too difficult for your child's level let me know and we can do something more based around describing pictures and images.
